pages.text: PARTS LIST There are two different kits available for Darkstalker. The first kit below is the full kit which includes PCB, all necessary graphics, buttons, joysticks and a volume/test bracket. This kit is used for a cabinet that will be upgraded with the CPS II board for the first time. The second kit is called the "B" Kit. This kit is for any that already uses the CPS II board (Super Street Fighter II). This kit includes the "B" board, all necessary graphics and volume/test bracket. You just remove the top cartridge off the motherboard and replace with the new cartridge. DK1000 Darkstalker Kit Part No. Description Qty. TEST MENU The test menu allows you to test the functions and controls of the game. These items include input devices such as joysticks, buttons and coin mechs, output devices such as monitor, speakers and meters. Through the Test Menu you can also access the Configuration Menu, where you can change the settings of the game. 1. ACCESSING THE TEST MENU . For a CAPCOM cabinet, or a cabinet equipped with a test switch: Turn on the main switch, then push the test switch. The screen shown below will appear. . For a cabinet without a test switch: Push the test switch on the side of the blue plastic electronic casing. Refer to the Controls Section of the manual. INPUT OUTPUT SOUND & VOICE COLOR DOT CROSS HATCH SYSTEM CONFIGURATION OBJECT SCROLL 1 SCROLL 2 SCROLL 3 MEMORY CHECK EXIT 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. 7. 8. 2. HOWTO SELECT AN ITEM . Use the Player 1 Joystick to Move the arrow in front of the desired item and press the Player 1 PUNCH LIGHT button. . To return to the test menu, push the Player 1 Start and Player 2 Start Buttons simultaneously. The test menu automatically appears: . After you exit the "6. SYSTEM CONFIGURATION MENU". . After the memory is tested on the menu of "11. MEMORY CHECK". 3. CLOSING THE TEST MENU To close the Test Menu, highlight "12, EXIT" and push the Player 1 LIGHT PUNCH button.

4. TEST MENU ITEM DESCRIPTIONS Used to test all the input switches. INPUT "1" appears when the switches are depressed. Check connections and switches in case "0" appears when swithces are depressed. OUTPUT Used to test the coin meter and the coin lock Select a code of SOUND or VOICE with the Player 1 Joystick. SOUND & VOICE Push the Player 1 A (LIGHT PUNCH) button to hear the sound of the selected code, then adjust the volume. Shows color bars of red, green, blue and white. COLOR Adjust RGB and brightness to obtain the optimum color balance and solid black background. DOT CROSS HATCH Used to test the screen size, focus and distortion. CONFIGURATION Used to change the game play settings. Refer to the CONFIGURATION MENU setion. OBJECT/SCROLLS Used to check all the characters of the game. Used to test memory. MEMORY CHECK "OK" appears when each block of memory passes test "ERROR" appears in case of malfunction. If "ERROR" appear, repeat the memory test. Contact your distributor if "ERROR" still appears. EXIT Select this item and push the Player 1 (Light Punch) button to return to game play mode.

pages.text: SYSTEM CONFIGURATION MENU 1. TO OPEN THE MENU . From the Test Menu, move the A character to "6. SYSTEM CONFIGURATION" and push the Player 1 LIGHT PUNCH button. The screen below will be displayed. CHANGING THE CONFIGURATION SETTINGS Move the Player 1 Joystick UP or DOWN to highlight the desired option. Once the option is highlighted, move the Joystick LEFT or RIGHT to change the setting. Refer to the menu on the next page for option settings. 3. SAVING SETTINGS AND CLOSING THE MENU Once the configuration settings are changed, save the new settings by selecting "EXIT" and pushing the Player 1 START button. A message "SAVING NEW CONFIGURATION IN EEPROM" appears while new settings are being saved. It takes one or two seconds to save the new settings. Do not turn off the power switch while saving is in process.

SYSTEM CONFIGURATION ITEM DESCRIPTIONS COIN Sets the charge per play GAME DIFFICULTY The higher the number, the more difficult the game play. Sets the level of offensive power. DAMAGE LEVEL The level of offensive power can be set in 9 steps. As the number increases the more powerful the level MONITOR FLIP Flips the screen. If the screen appears upside down, change the setting. ON: Upside down OFF: Right side up STEREO or MONAURAL. Sets continuous play. CONTINUE ON: Continuous play is possible OFF: Continuous play is not possible Sets whether or not it is possible to start a 1 player game from the 2 player side. START MODE ON: Game can be started from the 2 player side. OFF: Game cannot be started from the 2 player side. MONITOR FLIP Flips screen vertically. If the screen appears upside down, change the setting. Sets the number of rounds for winning. 1 ROUND: Winner of a single round wins MAX ROUND 3 ROUNDS: Winner of 2 out of 3 rounds wins. S ROUNDS: Winner of 3 out of 5 rounds wins. ATION When set to ON, body cutting scenes will not be shown and the color of REGULATIO! blood will be changed to blue. Sets the game speed. GAME SPEED TURBO 1 - 3: As the number increases, so does the speed. FREE SELECT: Players can select the speed of the game. FREE PLAY Sets the game for free play mode. HOW TO REMOVE THE TOP "B" CARTRIDGE In the future, there will be the capability to remove the top "B" cartridge so that a game can be converted to a new game or upgraded to a different version. It is very important only to seperate the top cartridge from the main board only. Dissasembling either case will void your warranty. Follow the instructions below to seperate the two assemblies. . Remove the 2 case clamps. . Carefully pull the the "B" cartridge off the bottom cartridge.
